errors.root_cause: The question does not name a relative, so the subject should default to the native. The solver shifted the event to the mother even though the same year creates a full penalty spanning natal chart and luck, directly supporting the native surgery option.
evidence: The rationale acknowledges the full penalty but discounts it because the day branch is not directly struck.
The mother option has only a broad parental-palace trigger and lacks a separate mother-star illness chain.
errors.counterfactual_fix: Apply the default-subject rule and demand independent relative-role evidence. This changes B to D.
regression_tests: An unspecified-subject event requires two independent relative-role signals before a parent or spouse option can beat a native-body option.
A salient clash, combination, or repetition must not decide the answer unless it reaches the queried role and event interface in the full structure.
